newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POWER GRID COMPANY TO ISSUE PLN 50 MLN CPS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POWER GRID COMPANY TO ISSUE PLN 50 MLN CPS.

text.p: The Polish Power Grid, Poland's second largest firm in terms of sales, plans to issue up to 50 million zloty of commercial papers and is likely to sell the first tranche in late February, the firm said on Thursday.

The firm's deputy president Zbigniew Kedzierski said the two-year CP programme, managed by Bank Handlowy in Warsaw, was approved on January 27 to raise funds for financing company's long-term investment.
"This is our first such programm, which enables to raise funds cheaper than through credit," Kedzierski told Reuters.
He added that company was also preparing for raising larger funds but probably through other debt instruments.
